mechanism: Fluconazole inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, reducing chlorpromazine metabolism and increasing its plasma concentration; both drugs also prolong QT interval and have CNS depressant effects.
action: Monitor for increased chlorpromazine adverse effects including sedation, orthostatic hypotension, and arrhythmias; consider dose reduction if toxicity occurs; perform baseline and periodic ECG monitoring.
